DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT
CHICAGO AREA OFFICE 17 NORTH DEARBORN STREET CHICAGO, ILLINOIS 60602
September 17, 1974
REGION V 300 South Wacker Drive Chicago, Illinois 00006
5.2PP:Downing
Mr. Sigmund C. Ziejewski District Engineer Illinois Department of Transportation Room 907 300 North State Street Chicago, Ill. 60610
Attention: H. M. Yamanaka, Mobility Studies Engineer
Subject: Review of . Involvement with 4(f) Lands
F.A. Route 23 Lincoln Highway, Cook County, Ill.
Dear Mr. Ziejewski:
We are responding to your request of September 5, 1974 for a review of Involvement with Section 4(f) Land in the above mentioned project.
We are aware of no significantly harmful effect that the temporary use of this 4(f) land west of Thorn Creek Bridge would have on this area.
Sincerely,
- John L. Waner
Director
